s: Din kavvanat habberakot ubo g' seipim: tzarik lekavven babberakot perush hammillot shemmotzi mippiv ukesheyyazkir hashshem — yekavven perush qeriato beale"p dale"t — leshon adnu"t, shehu adon hakkol. Vikavven od perush ketibato beyo"d he"a — leshon hvy"h, shehu: haya hoveh veyihyeh. Abal bemaqom sheggam ketibato hu beale"p dale"t — en tzarik lekavven ella shehu adon hakkol:

Bemaqom shekketibat hashshem hi beale"p dale"t — qorin haale"p ba"chatap pattach", ki ken hu naqud bammiqra. Abal bemaqom shekketibato hu beyo"d he"a — yesh qorin haale"p bi"sheba"a", kinquddat hayyo"d min shem hvy"h baruk hu, veyesh qorin haalep ba"chatap pattach", kinquddat haale"p beshem ale"p dale"t:
Ukesheyyazkir shem eloqim — yekavven shehu taqqip veammitz, asher lo haykolet baelyonim ubattachtonim:
